title: Sweet speech is a path, not polish
summary: Sweet speech is believable only when the life around it is humble. Return the mouth to praise before it carries hurt.
takeaway: Return the mouth to praise before it carries hurt.
lifeApplication: Before the next message leaves your mouth, pause with one breath and choose the sentence that can still be honored tonight.

source.shortMeaning: Sweet speech is believable only when the life around it is humble.
source.lifeApplication: Before using a gentle tone, let the body become humble too.

evidence.coreClaim: Sweet speech is believable only when the life around it is humble.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: when remembrance is real, it reaches the mouth and the walk.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before the next message leaves your mouth, pause with one breath and choose the sentence that can still be honored tonight.
